solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Yummy entrée containing eel skin

indicators.note: the word for the course wraps itself around the other piece

parts.note: an entrée is a dish served at a meal

indicators.note: the skin of a word is its outside pair of letters

explanation.surface: A tasty starter made with eel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entrée' is the dish itself here, not the course before the main one.
explanation.definitionFit: Delish is informal shorthand for delicious, which is what yummy means.

clue.text: Airless apartment indeed

indicators.note: the flat goes into the following word

explanation.surface: A stuffy apartment, indeed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'indeed' must be split into 'in' and 'deed', the container signal hiding inside one word.
explanation.definitionFit: A deflated tyre or balloon has had the air let out of it.

clue.text: Designer disrupted Cole Porter's finale, getting more hectic

indicators.note: disrupted means thrown into disorder, so the letters are mixed up
a finale is the end, so the closing letter of the name

explanation.surface: A songwriter's closing number interrupted by a frantic pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disrupted' rearranges only COLE, into LECO; Porter's 'finale' is R from his surname, the possessive S aside.
explanation.definitionFit: Le Corbusier was a Swiss-French modernist architect and furniture designer.

clue.text: See 28
Hustle and bustle starts in extravagant Dubai emirate

indicators.note: extravagant suggests wild, unrestrained behaviour, so the letters run wild into a new order
the starts of the three words are their opening letters

explanation.surface: The frenzied activity of lavish Dubai.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts' picks H, A, B from 'Hustle and bustle'; 'extravagant' then shuffles those with DUBAI.
explanation.definitionFit: Abu Dhabi is the largest of the seven United Arab Emirates and holds its capital.

clue.text: Relax and provoke?

definitions.meaning: split differently the letters say ..., to provoke or wind someone up

explanation.surface: Unwind, or stir someone up?
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the second sense needs the letters respaced.
explanation.definitionFit: Being relaxed and comfortable matches relax; teasing someone provokes them.

clue.text: Extremely devious extramarital affairs

indicators.note: extra here means outside, so the end letters sit outside the marriage word
the extremes of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: a marriage is an alliance, so marital points to alliance

explanation.surface: Very sneaky cheating on a spouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extramarital' is read as 'extra' (outside) plus 'marital', so the end letters of devious sit outside the marriage word.
explanation.definitionFit: Dalliances are casual romances or flings, so affairs fits.

clue.text: Make things worse for a theologian to sin until corrected by group of twelve

parts.note: DD is the abbreviation for Doctor of Divinity

indicators.note: a corrected text has its letters put right, so they are rearranged

parts.note: a jury traditionally has twelve members

explanation.surface: A divine sinning until set right by a court panel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corrected' rearranges TO SIN UNTIL into INSULT TO IN.
explanation.definitionFit: To add insult to injury is an idiom for making a bad situation worse.

clue.text: See 7
Clientele speaking of cowsheds

indicators.note: speaking means the word is said out loud and matched by its sound

parts.note: a shop's clientele are its buyers

explanation.surface: Talking about customers in barns.
explanation.definitionFit: A byre is a Scottish and northern English word for a cowshed.

clue.text: Skill of teachers

definitions.meaning: the teaching staff of a university or school department is collectively its ...

explanation.surface: The ability that educators possess.
explanation.definitionFit: One word covers both a mental power or knack and the body of academic staff.

clue.text: Everybody used different hints

indicators.note: made different, the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Everyone gave assorted tips.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' rearranges USED to UDES.
explanation.definitionFit: To allude is to refer indirectly, which is what someone who hints does.

clue.text: Careful backing half that's wrong

indicators.note: only the front half of the word is turned back to front

explanation.surface: Supporting caution only halfway leads you astray.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing half' turns only WA, the first half of WARY, giving AW + RY.
explanation.definitionFit: Something gone awry has gone amiss, off course from what was planned.

clue.text: Favourable belief I can reform

indicators.note: to reform is to form again, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: An optimistic claim that a conviction can be changed for the better.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reform' rearranges BELIEF, I and CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Beneficial means advantageous, having a good effect, as a favourable outcome does.

clue.text: Intercourse made easy by these ships

definitions.meaning: social intercourse means conversation, eased by opening games or remarks
vessels built to cut channels through frozen sea

explanation.surface: Vessels that make dealings simpler.
explanation.definitionFit: Party games that get strangers talking and vessels that crack polar ice share the name.

clue.text: See 28
One of five in the middle of Greece getting a horse?

indicators.note: the quintuplet word sits in between the central letters
the middle of a six-letter word is its central pair of letters

parts.note: a quin is one of quintuplets, five babies born together

explanation.surface: A quintuplet in central Greece acquiring a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits that a mostly adjectival word is being used as a noun for the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: An equine is any member of the horse family, a horse being the obvious example.

clue.text: Like below, in separate parts

explanation.surface: As below, split into pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Torn asunder means broken apart, divided into pieces.

clue.text: Austrian in a whirl?

definitions.meaning: a ... whirl is a British piped butter biscuit, so this sense belongs in that name

explanation.surface: An Austrian spinning about.
explanation.walkthrough: A Viennese whirl is a British teatime biscuit of swirled piped shortbread.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes a native of Vienna and also names the biscuit called a Viennese whirl.

clue.text: See 7
One's out in this close draw

parts.note: a tie is a drawn match in sport

explanation.surface: Someone is eliminated in this tight drawn contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' means asleep, out for the night, not knocked out of a game.
explanation.definitionFit: A nightdress is the garment worn while sleeping, when a sleeper is out cold.

clue.text: Strange individual Dior design by the Financial Times

parts.note: the newspaper refers to itself as we, the editorial first person

indicators.note: to design is to arrange, so the letters are laid out anew

explanation.surface: A Dior creation featured in the FT is something odd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'design' rearranges DIOR to IRDO, which is put by WE.
explanation.definitionFit: A weirdo is an informal term for an eccentric or odd person.

clue.text: Organ music samples essentially sounding thin

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its centre, so its middle letter
sounding means the word is said out loud and spelt by its sound

explanation.surface: Organ recordings with a weak tone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' picks S and P, the centres of music and samples; 'Organ' looks musical but is the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: The spleen is an abdominal organ that filters blood.

clue.text: Start to fiddle with one instrument or another …

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a lute is a stringed instrument

explanation.surface: Begin playing violin alongside one instrument or another.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'another' instrument, beside the lute; the ellipsis runs on to the next clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The flute is a woodwind, a different instrument from the lute.

clue.text: Before the French returned telegram in pink and purple

indicators.note: the built-up word comes before the French article
the turned-back word sits in the middle of the colour word
returned means sent back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a wire is an old word for a telegram

explanation.surface: A colour description mixing pink and purple, with a French touch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pink' looks like part of the colour definition but is wordplay; 'Before' sets the built word ahead of the French article.
explanation.definitionFit: Periwinkle is a lavender-blue to purple shade named after the flower.

clue.text: Seafood not right for man on board

indicators.note: not removes the following letter from the word

parts.note: a prawn is a shellfish eaten as seafood

explanation.surface: Seafood is wrong for a man on a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'board' is a chessboard, not a ship's deck.
explanation.definitionFit: A pawn is one of the chessmen, the pieces that stand on the chessboard.

clue.text: … and ring in gong for a third

indicators.note: the ring sits in the middle of the honour

parts.note: gong is British slang for a medal or honour such as the OBE
a ring is round, like the letter O

explanation.surface: Continuing the list of instruments, a ring and a gong.
explanation.walkthrough: OBE is the Order of the British Empire, a British honour. After the lute and flute of the previous clue, this is 'a third' instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The oboe is a double-reed woodwind, a further instrument in the sequence.

clue.text: Lost ten Euro on the way

indicators.note: lost suggests something astray, so the letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone dropped a ten-euro note while travelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lost' rearranges TEN and EURO.
explanation.definitionFit: En route is the French-derived phrase for during the journey, in transit.

clue.text: Double NHS wait, turn for treatment and make things worse

indicators.note: letters given treatment are worked over and reshaped

explanation.surface: Hospital waiting times doubled before you are seen, which only aggravates matters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for treatment' rearranges DOUBLE NHS WAIT TURN. The NHS is Britain's National Health Service.
explanation.definitionFit: This idiom means to aggravate someone's pain or misfortune further.

clue.text: Thanks boyfriend about love's first scene

parts.note: ta is informal British for thanks

indicators.note: about means around, so the boyfriend word goes around the letter
the first of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Thanking a boyfriend for the romantic opening moment.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is informal British thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: A tableau is a picturesque grouping of people, a frozen scene, especially on stage.

clue.text: What hampers investigations into murder of inconsequential people

definitions.meaning: read as two words, ..., the lack of a corpse which stalls a murder inquiry

explanation.surface: The absence that thwarts detectives, or people who don't count.
explanation.definitionFit: Nobodies are people without status, and split in two the word describes a missing corpse.

clue.text: Lively Faeroe Islands temporarily vacated

indicators.note: each word is emptied of its inside, leaving only its outer letters

explanation.surface: The Faroe Islands briefly empty yet still spirited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vacated' leaves FE, IS and TY.
explanation.definitionFit: Feisty means spirited and full of energy, often combatively so.
